title: centaurea drabifolia subsp. libanotica
intro: Centaurea drabifolia subsp. libanotica, commonly known as the mountain centaury, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea drabifolia subsp. libanotica include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils that contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the plant's potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
